title: Rowdy Boats
specs: Access to Party Cove, a popular floating party spot on Percy Priest Lake
All guests must sign an online waiver before boarding
Private groups only; price covers whole boat, not per person

blurb: Rowdy Boats offers captained party pontoon rentals on Percy Priest Lake with a capacity of up to 22 guests per boat. Rentals include a licensed captain, coolers, ice, water toys like lily pads and pool noodles, and a premium sound system. The standard cruise duration is 3 hours, with customizable packages for events like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and corporate outings.
extraNote: Full payment required at booking; all sales are final · 100% refund if cancelled more than 21 days before tour · Cancellations 8-20 days before tour get 100% valued gift card, transferable, no expiration · Cancellations less than 7 days before tour are non-refundable · No refunds for no-shows or late arrivals over 30 minutes · Trips not cancelled for rain; captains decide on dangerous weather · If trip cancelled before departure due to weather, 100% valued gift card issued, no refunds · Pro-rated refunds only if trip cancelled during the trip due to weather · Trips terminated early for illegal drug use, underage drinking, unsafe or disruptive behavior with no refund · Pickup location provide
